description: Ventsim is commercial software for underground mine and tunnel ventilation. Ventsim DESIGN, which the vendor describes as the best-selling mine ventilation software with more than 2,500 mines, universities, consultants, government and research organisations as users, is a three-dimensional package for designing and testing ventilation circuits: airflow, pressure, heat, gases, power, radon, fire and contaminant spread. Ventsim CONTROL is a ventilation-on-demand system that connects to underground sensors and fans to monitor, control, automate and optimise airflow, heating and cooling, in use in mines and tunnels in Australia, Canada, China, Mexico, Peru, Poland and elsewhere. The software runs on Windows desktops for design and on site servers for control, and is sold under commercial licences with pricing on request. Caveats: it is proprietary, models are built by each user for their own mine, and no public model library or open data come with it. For simulation it covers network flow of air, fire and smoke scenarios for emergency response, and digital-twin style operational control of underground infrastructure such as mines and road or rail tunnels. Related catalogue records include the MSHA mine data sets, which record accidents that ventilation models are used to prevent.
